headline: HuyenBao v11.31 — gỡ banner «🗄 Chế độ máy chủ» khỏi trang chủ (chế độ SQLite sống im lặng như Supabase)
summary: QUIET SERVER MODE. The green '🗄 Chế độ máy chủ — SQLite tự host trên VPS này…' banner that sat on top of the community views (chat / friends / leaderboard) on the self-hosted VPS is gone. Live backends now render no banner at all — Supabase mode already behaved this way, SQLite mode now matches. Players just see the community features working. The error banner (⚠ connection problem, with retry) and the demo-mode setup guide (🧪, only when no backend exists) are untouched. The now-unused soc.sqlite i18n string was removed from all three languages.
features: Community banner removed for sqlite mode — same as supabase, live backends are silent
Error banner (⚠ + retry) and demo setup guide (🧪) unchanged
Version bumped to v11.31 at FRONT of app name
